_comment: MNN B-Roll Search Engine settings. Copy this file to config.json and edit. Paths may use forward slashes (Z:/B-Roll Footage) or escaped backslashes (Z:\\B-Roll Footage). UNC paths like //server/share/B-Roll also work.

auto_index._comment: Re-index automatically once per day. run_on_launch indexes when the app opens if more than interval_hours has passed since the last run.

_web_comment: Settings for the browsable gallery (default UI). web_port is the localhost port; preview_max_width/seconds control the size/length of generated hover-preview clips.

validation._comment: Tuning for the Phase 1 mapped-drive connection check. listing_timeout_seconds guards against a hung/slow network drive; warn_if_empty flags a reachable folder that contains no footage (often a sign SharePoint sync is behind).
